notes: Same access pass as Bestsellers/Clearance (see those files for full method notes): direct HTTP GET, no block, robots.txt clean, SSR grid pages self-report exact totals via 'Showing N of TOTAL' + matching JSON 'count'. Header nav has an explicit 'New Arrivals' entry (id=new-arrivals -> /browse/100/new) with one genuine child in the Outdoor mega-menu, 'New In Outdoor' (id=outdoor-get-inspired-new-in -> /browse/167/outdoor-new). Checked all 221 nav id/url/name triples for 'new'/'just in'/'latest'/'recently added' - no other room- or category-specific New Arrivals pages exist beyond these two. Both pages were opened and inspected per the brief's Collection-page test: /browse/100/new has H1 id='new-arrivals' with literal text 'New Arrivals' and breadcrumbTitle 'New Arrivals'; /browse/167/outdoor-new has breadcrumbTitle 'New in Outdoor'. Both are genuine filterable/sortable product grids (not lookbook/editorial pages) - this is the site's standard /browse/ category-listing template, the same one used for every ordinary category, so there is no ambiguity about them being real PLPs. No 'New Collection'/'New Season'-named page was found anywhere in nav, category_sitemap.xml, collection_sitemap.xml, landingpage_sitemap.xml, or tag_sitemap.xml (only tag hits were /tag/53/new-items and /tag/54/new-products, both superseded/legacy Contentful tag pages not linked from live nav, so not opened separately). Did not use site search (/search?*) - robots.txt disallows it and nav/sitemap discovery already positively confirmed both listings.
